# canary

The verified Claude Code version range, canary tiers, and the fragments tools/versions regenerates.

Read first: `docs/features/canary/spec.md`, `docs/features/canary/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/canary-drives-installed-claude-through-production-chain` — The canary launches the installed claude through the production settings, shell, wrapper and enveloped POST chain; previously skipped field tests are binding. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-drives-installed-claude-through-production-chain.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-exact-pin-bumped-after-green-runs` — Muster pins one exact Claude Code version, and the pin moves only after the canary has run green against the new version. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-exact-pin-bumped-after-green-runs.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-interactive-dialog-rows-accepted-residual` — Behaviours behind an interactive dialog (plan mode, PermissionRequest, Notification, SubagentStop) stay outside the canary and are verified by probe on demand. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-interactive-dialog-rows-accepted-residual.md`
- `kb:adr/process-interface-probe-rig-in-repo` — Wire-format questions are answered by the in-repo probe rig through the interface-probe skill, against the real pinned binary, with findings in spikes/. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: canary) → `docs/adr/process-interface-probe-rig-in-repo.md`
- `kb:fact/config-dir-breaks-oauth` — CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolates settings, hooks and transcripts but breaks subscription OAuth ("Not logged in · Please run /login"). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, launch) → `docs/facts/config-dir-breaks-oauth.md`
- `kb:fact/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence` — Headless claude -p fires the full hook sequence, including the command-wrapped SessionStart, so hook probes need no tmux. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/facts/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit` — On the authentication-failure exit Claude Code does not wait for hook children: StopFailure is at risk and SessionEnd is usually lost. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.246..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, canary) → `docs/facts/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/status-version-matches-installed` — The status-line version field equals the installed claude --version. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, connection) → `docs/facts/status-version-matches-installed.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-exit` — The workspace-trust prompt preselects "No, exit" (2.1.259+): a bare Enter exits the session; the harness moves the marker first. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-exit.md`
